comparisons.reason: Different constructs over the same source. Feature 0 requires an analogy: an explicit comparison of the issue to a different familiar scenario, and it excludes plain literal examples of the same issue. Feature 1 counts any specific, concrete, particularized example, including literal instances of the issue itself and hypothetical scenarios, and it needs no comparison to a different domain. Many comments would score 1 on feature 1 and 0 on feature 0. Their quotation exclusions also differ.
